meta.name: onboard
meta.description: Design or improve onboarding flows, empty states, and first-time user experiences. Helps users get started successfully and understand value quickly.

copy.tagline: 设计新手引导流程，帮助用户快速上手
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计或优化产品的首次用户体验
copy.tagline_en: Design onboarding flows to help users get started quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or improving first-time user experiences

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计或改进新手引导流程、空状态页面和首次使用体验，让用户快速上手并理解产品价值。
howto.when: 当你需要为新功能或产品区域设计引导流程，或优化空状态、工具提示等首次使用体验时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新手引导流程，让用户快速创建第一个项目。
say.note: Claude 会输出引导步骤和示例文案。

say.text: 这个页面的空状态该怎么写？
say.note: Claude 会提供空状态文案和设计建议。

say.text: 如何用渐进式引导介绍高级功能？
say.note: Claude 会给出分步引导方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design or improve onboarding flows, empty states, and first-time user experiences to help users get started and understand value quickly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design onboarding for a new feature or area, or optimize empty states, tooltips, and first-use experiences.

say_en.text: Design an onboarding flow to help users create their first project.
say_en.note: Claude will output steps and example copy.

say_en.text: What should the empty state for this page look like?
say_en.note: Claude will provide copy and design suggestions.

say_en.text: How to introduce advanced features progressively?
say_en.note: Claude will propose a step-by-step guide.
